$comment: Overlay on spec/mainspec_v2.json: where the live instance departs from the spec.
Spec is the source of truth about the SHAPE of the API; this file is the source of truth
about where reality differs. Every entry was reproduced live on
Consumed by tools/gen_registry.py and by App.Admin.Client.

instance_verified.server_version: IRIS for UNIX (Ubuntu Server LTS for ARM64 Containers) 2026.2 (Build 221U) Fri Jun 26 2026 09:59:12 EDT

client_behaviour.$comment: Flags App.Admin.Client must honour for every call.

errorEnvelope.rule: Parse status.errors[]. Branch on .id and .code, NEVER on the HTTP status.
errorEnvelope.doNotRenderFrom: status.summary - it is HTML-escaped ('), errors[].error is not
errorEnvelope.nested: errors[].errors[] appears on datatype validation failures - flatten recursively
errorEnvelope.note: 401 and route-level 404 return a zero-length body. 403 from a privilege denial returns the envelope with an EMPTY errors array - no machine-readable reason.

login.actual: flat body: {access_token, refresh_token, sub, iat, exp} - no result wrapper
login.rule: Read token fields from the top level. Refresh proactively before every batch; 60s is short enough that a slow screen will otherwise 401 mid-render.
login.absentFromLiveSpec: /login, /logout, /refresh, /revoke are missing from the instance's own generated spec but DO work
login.revokeEqualsLogout: both kill access AND refresh for the whole session

basicAuthFallback.$comment: Not a drift - a release-model constraint. :latest is 2026.1, where /login returns 401 and /v2/* is 404.
basicAuthFallback.rule: Basic auth is the primary path and works on 2026.1 and 2026.2. Probe POST /login once at startup; enable JWT only if it answers 200.

async.rule: The 202 body is an EMPTY envelope and carries no task id. Read the GUID from the LOCATION response header.
async.headerVersionMismatch: header points at v1 while we call v2; both answer for the same GUID
async.perUser: Tasks are strictly private: another user gets 404 LoadObjectNotFound, and their /v2/async-results is empty. A shared 'what is running now' screen is impossible on this API.
async.note: Async tasks keep running with no client attached - verified by abandoning the connection.

listTruncation.rule: detectTruncation - lists silently cut at 1000 rows with NO indicator in the response.
listTruncation.mitigation: Always send an explicit maxRows. If rows == maxRows, treat the page as possibly truncated and warn.
listTruncation.noPagination: no offset / skip / page / sort parameter exists on any list endpoint - paginate and sort client-side
listTruncation.filterSemantics: case-insensitive substring across the WHOLE row, not just the name column
listTruncation.namesParamInstead: /v2/security/users takes names=a,b or names=* (also capped at 1000)

statusCodes.rule: The same logical condition maps to different HTTP codes per endpoint - never branch on status alone.

privilegeAnnotations.rule: The (%Priv:U) annotation is a LOWER BOUND, not a sufficient condition. Show it as 'requires at least'; the verdict is the live 403.
privilegeAnnotations.regexWarning: The same regex WITHOUT digits ([A-Za-z_]+) silently drops all 24 %Admin_OAuth2_* operations. Use the pattern above.

twoKindsOf403.protectDenial: ObjectScriptError 5002 <PROTECT> - a database resource is missing, not a privilege; leaks internal routine names and paths, so never surface it raw

privilegeAnnotations.effectivePrivileges: GET /info -> result.privileges is the live map for the current user - use it to gate the UI

referentialValidation.rule: preCheck: roleExists - the API does NOT validate references.
referentialValidation.evidence: POST /v2/security/user with Roles:["%NoSuchRole_XYZ"] returns 201 Created and stores the bogus role
referentialValidation.mitigation: Validate role names against security.roles.list before any create/update that sets Roles.

requestBodyShape.rule: Roles and EscalationRoles are ARRAYS. Passing a string returns 400 RequestBodyFieldShouldBeObject (40308).
requestBodyShape.createUserBody: {"User":{...}, "Password":"..."} with the name in the query string
requestBodyShape.malformedJson: a body that is not valid JSON is not reported as a parse error - it comes back as 40301 MissingRequestBodyField per required field

emptyPostBody.rule: Always send a body on POST and PUT, even an empty object: operations whose arguments are all query parameters otherwise fail.
emptyPostBody.evidence: POST /v2/task/suspend?id=12 with no body -> 400 PostedDataNoContent (16003); the same call with {} -> 200; POST /v2/task/resume with no body -> 200

suspendedFlag.rule: Do not trust Suspended from GET /v2/tasks - it is always false. Read %SYS.Task.Suspended (0 none, 1 left in queue, 2 removed and rescheduled) through the manual tool task.states.
suspendedFlag.evidence: POST /v2/task/suspend -> 200, %SYS.Task.Suspended=1, GET /v2/tasks still reports Suspended=false; GET /v2/task has no such field

operation_patches.$comment: JSON-Patch-style corrections applied per operation before schema generation.

patch.reason: declared in the spec, never returned by the instance
spec says integer, instance returns a string
spec spells EXEName, the instance returns EXEname - differs only in the case of the N

GET /v2/security/oauth2/client/client-co.note: serverId is required (spec agrees). A call without it returns 400 MissingQueryParam - surface it as a required field in the UI, not as an error.

patch.reason: AsyncTaskBase declares GUID but the single-task response omits it; carry the GUID we captured from LOCATION instead

excluded.$comment: Declared in the spec but deliberately NOT generated.

POST /v2/security/oauth2/revoke.reason: declared in mainspec_v2.json but absent from the instance's own spec - do not generate

/v1/*.reason: 170 undocumented v1 operations live on the instance; we use none of them, except the URL handed to us in the LOCATION header

open_questions: OAuth2ServerDefinition vs observed ServerDefinition - reported in the neighbouring entry (agammann/iris-workbench); NOT reproduced on our instance yet. Verify before relying on it, then record it here.
